user_story: As a user, I want to be able to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can add a new todo by typing in the input field with `data-testid: text-input` and pressing Enter. 2. The user can complete a todo by clicking the checkbox with `id: toggle-all`. 3. The user can delete completed todos by clicking the button with `class: clear-completed`. 4. The todo list updates correctly after each action, and the URL remains the same when adding an empty todo.
